final_message:
The change will likely fail the hidden API tests.

The list endpoint is correctly switched to visible-only content. However, the hidden-box check was added to `manageBoxByCode`, which appears to be the singular/private route because a separate `@GetMapping("/content/boxes/{code}")` follows it. The required plural storefront lookup therefore remains able to return hidden boxes.

VERDICT: FAIL
CONFIDENCE: 88
